text:
noah: Deploy to prod completed, rolling traffic -> 100% (10:03 PT). @ravi you're primary for smoke checks, can you run quick health probes and signal? thanks

devops-bot: release 2026-04-21T10:03:00Z (auto) deployment succeeded - canary->stable

ravi: On it. Hitting canary and a few recent user routes. Will paste light checks in a sec.

ravi: curl check: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq .status` -> "ok". Also `/v1/generate` quick sample: latency 180ms, tokens 64. No obvious errors.

emily: Quick glance at Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc/prod-overview p50 +5ms, p95 +22ms, error rate 0.02% (baseline 0.01%). keeping watch for 15m.

alex: Logs show a small noisy kvcache miss pattern on runtime-2 around 10:04. grabbing logs:
```
kubectl logs -l app=runtime,pod=runtime-2 -c inference --since=2m | grep -i kvcache
[10:04:12] warn kvcache miss key=abcdef
[10:04:13] info fill cache done
```

julie: I flipped the routing flag to prefer hot-kv on runtime-2 to reduce misses. rolling restart runtime-2 (1/1)

julie: command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-2` (started)

ravi: After restart, a quick sample: latency back to 160ms, no kvcache warnings in last 30s. Good.

emily: Metrics now p95 - down 10ms versus peak. Error rate steady. :thumbsup:

noah: Nice. Who's oncall if we need rollback? @ravi is ok but also calling @alex to be ready.

alex: I'm here. Rollback procedure if needed:
```
# rollback to previous stable
redwoodctl deploy rollback --release-id=2026-04-21-09:50
```
I've got the command ready, will execute if we see error rate > 0.2% or latency > +150ms sustained for 5m.

ravi: Agree. Setting a short alert: if errors >0.15% or p95 > 350ms for 5m I trigger rollback.

devops-bot: alert created: prod-release-1800123456-watch (thresholds: errors>0.15%, p95>350ms, window:5m)

noah: Great. If nothing else in 20m we'll mark this deployed and close handoff. Thanks team. :raised_hands:

emily: I'll leave a short note in release notes channel in 25m with metrics snapshot.

julie: marking runtime-2 as observed-ok in deploy checklist.

alex: keep an eye on long-prompt workloads, leaving a small logging tweak to capture avg seq len for next hour.

ravi: All set from my side, monitoring.

noah: Closing in 20. If any regressions call me or ping #eng-oncall.
